description: This Java class 'Capabilities' models the capabilities and configurations of a Nextcloud server instance, including version info, sharing permissions, UI colors, and supported features. It is an entity for persistence with Room database annotations.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Entity class representing server capabilities, including version info, sharing permissions, UI colors, and feature flags.

methods.name: isReSharingAllowed
methods.description: Returns whether re-sharing is permitted.

methods.name: setReSharingAllowed
methods.description: Sets the re-sharing permission flag.

methods.name: getPublicPasswordEnforced
methods.description: Returns whether public password enforcement is enabled.

methods.name: setPublicPasswordEnforced
methods.description: Sets the public password enforcement flag.

methods.name: getDefaultPermission
methods.description: Returns the default permission setting.

methods.name: setDefaultPermission
methods.description: Sets the default permission.

methods.name: getAskForOptionalPassword
methods.description: Returns whether asking for optional password is enabled.

methods.name: setAskForOptionalPassword
methods.description: Sets the ask-for-optional-password flag.

methods.name: setApiVersion
methods.description: Sets the API version string.

methods.name: getApiVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the API version.

methods.name: getETag
methods.description: Returns the ETag string.

methods.name: getNextcloudMajorVersion
methods.description: Returns the major version of Nextcloud.

methods.name: getNextcloudMinorVersion
methods.description: Returns the minor version of Nextcloud.

methods.name: getNextcloudMicroVersion
methods.description: Returns the micro version of Nextcloud.

methods.name: setNextcloudMajorVersion
methods.description: Sets the major version of Nextcloud.

methods.name: setNextcloudMinorVersion
methods.description: Sets the minor version of Nextcloud.

methods.name: setNextcloudMicroVersion
methods.description: Sets the micro version of Nextcloud.

methods.name: getFederationShare
methods.description: Returns whether federation sharing is enabled.

methods.name: setFederationShare
methods.description: Enables or disables federation sharing.

methods.name: setETag
methods.description: Sets the ETag string.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the primary color of the capabilities.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the primary color.

methods.name: getTextColor
methods.description: Returns the text color used in UI.

methods.name: setTextColor
methods.description: Sets the text color.

methods.name: isDirectEditingAvailable
methods.description: Checks if direct editing is supported.

methods.name: setDirectEditingAvailable
methods.description: Sets the support for direct editing.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the capabilities object, summarizing key fields.
